user.title: Melodious hub
user.description: Home Assistant entities become devices on your Melodious Harmony hub, for activities and remote buttons. The hub calls Home Assistant back over plain http, so give an address the hub can reach on your network.

data.username: Hub username (if the web UI has a password)
data.ha_url: Home Assistant URL for the hub (http://…)

error.http_only: Use a plain http:// address; the hub can't check https certificates.

abort.already_configured: This hub is already set up.

init.title: Devices on the hub
init.description: Each entity becomes a device on the hub. Removing one takes it off the hub, unless an activity or button still uses it.
